address: 29 Doan Van Bo, Xom Chieu, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 70-year Northern-style pho institution founded 1948, now second-generation and relocated to the Xom Chieu market area of District 4; a simple, garnish-light bowl that sells nearly 400 servings a day.

address: 50 Ham Nghi, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Iconic Saigon banh mi brand founded 1968 by Nguyen Thi Dau; from a single Ham Nghi kiosk it grew into a citywide institution famed for its pate, gio cha and mid-autumn cakes.
dish: banh mi thap cam (pate & gio cha, since 1968)

address: Hem Cach Mang Thang Tam, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A ~30-year alley pha lau whose broth is simmered in fresh coconut water for a sweet, naturally brown offal stew; a cult afternoon snack that stays packed despite its hidden location.

n: Sup Cua Nha Tho Duc Ba
address: 84 Nguyen Du, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A signless ~30-year crab-soup pushcart beside Notre-Dame Cathedral, known citywide simply as 'sup cua nha tho Duc Ba'; rich crab soup finished with century egg.
dish: sup cua (crab soup with century egg)

address: Hem 136 Nguyen Thien Thuat, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The oldest Teochew (Tieu) porridge in Saigon, a family cart since 1942 at the edge of Ban Co market; each bowl cooked to order with pork organs, squid and local egg.

n: Banh Canh Cua Ngo Duc Ke
address: 48 Ngo Duc Ke, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A near-40-year crab banh canh handed down from mother Nguyen Thi Be of Tra Vinh; thick tapioca noodles in crab broth on a famous downtown food street.

address: Hem Phan Dinh Phung, Phu Nhuan District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 30+-year sidewalk com tam in a Phu Nhuan alley run by the petite 'Ba Rom' (Nguyen Thi Suong); honey-grilled pork chop plus a dozen sides, deliberately never expanded.
dish: com tam suon (grilled pork chop rice, 30+ years)

address: 239 Luong Nhu Hoc, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Saigon's priciest crab soup (up to 395,000d), sold by Hoa cook Co Lan (Giang Thi Huong) since 1993 in Cholon; the 'sup cua bong bong ca' adds fish maw.
dish: sup cua bong bong ca (crab & fish-maw soup)

address: 455 Nguyen Trai, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A three-generation Cholon mi vit tiem: a quarter-duck in medicinal broth over hand-made egg noodles; the top bowl (abalone & sea cucumber) runs to 350,000d.

address: Hem 460 Dien Bien Phu (goc Cao Thang), District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: One of Saigon's oldest savory-xoi carts (60+ years) at the Cao Thang - Dien Bien Phu corner; a Hoa family recipe of sticky rice with spiced rolled pork.

n: Banh Cuon La Chuoi Hai Tan
address: Sap 22I cho Nguyen Tri Phuong, 68 Nguyen Lam, Ward 6, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 60+-year Nam Dinh-style banh cuon stall inside Nguyen Tri Phuong market, uniquely wrapped in banana leaf; recipe brought south in the 1950s by Ba Hai Tan.
dish: banh cuon la chuoi (banana-leaf steamed rice rolls)

n: Chao Vit Thanh Da Goc Nha La
address: Duong Binh Quoi, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: One of Thanh Da peninsula's two legendary duck-congee houses (licensed 1980, older in practice), on riverside Binh Quoi; cháo vit paired with goi vit.

address: 22 Phan Boi Chau, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A ~50-year Mekong-style bun mam beside Ben Thanh market, long a sidewalk stall before moving indoors; pungent fermented-fish broth loaded with seafood and pork.

address: Nguyen Phi Khanh, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A signless 50+-year che cart (the red three-wheeler) nicknamed 'che chanh' for its famously curt owner; only two items - bean che and tapioca-pearl che.
dish: che dau & che bot bang (bean & tapioca-pearl sweet soup)

address: Goc Nguyen Trai - Chau Van Liem, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A Cholon Hoa chicken-rice house dating to 1945, famed among gourmets for tender poached chicken with a ginger fish-sauce dip.

address: 88 Nguyen Hue (in the alley), Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A half-century, signless bun thit nuong hidden behind an art gallery at 88 Nguyen Hue; Ba Hoang Thi Them's Southern-style grilled pork and cha gio since the 1960s.
dish: bun thit nuong cha gio (grilled pork vermicelli)

n: Bun Bo Lau Bo Giao Toan
address: 218 Quoc lo 1K, Linh Xuan Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A cavernous 400m2 beef institution on Highway 1K selling nearly a tonne of beef a day - 'as big as a market' - known for both bun bo and beef hotpot.
dish: bun bo & lau bo (beef noodle & beef hotpot)

address: Tran Quang Khai, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 30+-year com tam opened by Nguyen Kieu Giang in 1989; honey-glazed grilled pork chop and a signature sour catfish thau canh chua ca hu.
dish: com tam suon & canh chua ca hu (grilled pork rice)

n: Hu Tieu Mi Suon 105 Lo Sieu
address: 105 Lo Sieu, Ward 16, District 11, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The busiest Hoa noodle stall on Cholon's Lo Sieu, famed for extra-long uncut pork ribs over hand-made egg noodles; 20-30 minute queues.

address: Xom Chieu, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A beloved District 4 snail spot at the end of Xom Chieu, named for serving in bowls (to); dozens of snail and shellfish dishes, packed after dark.

address: Goc Nguyen Dinh Chieu - Ban Co, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A Ban Co balut cart selling 3,000-6,000 eggs a day; the signature is hot vit lon simmered in coconut water.
dish: hot vit lon nuoc dua (balut in coconut water)

address: 283 Xo Viet Nghe Tinh, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Two neighbouring 40+-year plain-congee stalls at Hang Xanh (Hang Xanh Goc & Thanh Binh), a late-night ritual of pandan congee with ~20 salty toppings.
dish: chao trang la dua (pandan congee with toppings)

address: Khu Bay Hien (cho Ba Hoa), Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: One of the oldest, most authentic mi Quang houses in Saigon's Quang-immigrant Bay Hien quarter, a fixture for Quang Nam natives for nearly two decades.

address: Cho dem Hanh Thong Tay, Go Vap District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The standout stall of Hanh Thong Tay night market, known for silky all-natural caramel flan alongside banh beo and ram bap.

address: Hoang Sa, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A three-generation Hue kitchen on the Nhieu Loc canal whose banh beo/nam/bot loc trace to a grandmother who sold Hue food in Emperor Bao Dai's era.
dish: banh beo, nam, bot loc (Hue steamed cakes)

address: 200/48 Xom Chieu, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A District 4 alley pha lau near Xom Chieu market, a must-try of the area's snack scene; beef offal braised for 20+ years.

address: Hem Ton Dan, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A near-40-year pha lau tucked in a Ton Dan alley, the first stall on District 4's famous pha lau row; coconut-braised offal.

address: Dong Den, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: 'Viet kieu' bun bo by Ba Tam, who cooked her mother's Hue recipe for 40 years in Laos before bringing it home; ~700 bowls a day, tuned sweeter for Saigon.

n: Banh Mi Ba Tau (bo la lot)
address: Le Duc Tho, Go Vap District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A signless 40+-year banh mi cart in Go Vap run by Lieu Ngoc Thanh; the signature is bo la lot (betel-leaf beef) with crushed peanuts.
dish: banh mi bo la lot (betel-leaf beef banh mi)

address: Hem 149F Tran Quang Khai, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 40-year alley goat-curry once crowned 'Saigon's number-one ca ri de' by an American paper; rich Cham-Indian-style goat curry eaten with bread or rice.

n: Ca Ri Ga Cho Xa Tay
address: Goc Nguyen Trai - Phu Dong Thien Vuong (cho Xa Tay), District 5, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 40-year Hoa-style chicken-and-duck curry vendor at Cholon's Xa Tay market, a neighbourhood institution.

address: 6C Tu Xuong, Ward 7, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A well-loved bun bo cooked to the An Cuu (Hue) recipe by the couple Ut and Hung; a deep-red, beefy broth.

n: Banh Beo Co Anh Cho Ben Thanh
address: Cua Tay cho Ben Thanh, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A ~30-year Hue banh beo stall at Ben Thanh market's west gate selling up to 1,000 plates a day, plus nam, bot loc and banh it tran.

address: 144 Phan Dang Luu, Phu Nhuan District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A discreet 20+-year evening chao long on Phan Dang Luu with a loyal following; congee with assorted pork organs, ginger and pepper.

n: Bun Rieu Oc Nguyen Canh Chan
address: Nguyen Canh Chan, Cau Kho Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A signless, Northern-style bun rieu oc known only by its street name; crab paste, snails and tomato broth without liver or tofu.
